g.text: Tether and battery are alternative protected sources and are not paralleled. HR-30 contactors are not assumed to be the HR-V0 LC1D25BD selection.

g.desc: Tether and battery are alternative protected sources and are not paralleled. HR-30 contactors are not assumed to be the HR-V0 LC1D25BD selection.

g.text: NOTE 2: SRH1 reset/EDM loop mirrors the V0 logic, but HR-30 contactor terminal numbers remain intentionally unresolved.

g.desc: NOTE 2: SRH1 reset/EDM loop mirrors the V0 logic, but HR-30 contactor terminal numbers remain intentionally unresolved.

g.text: NOTE 1: HR-V0 and HR-30 are separate build variants. Their safety components are not installed or cross-wired as one assembly.

g.desc: NOTE 1: HR-V0 and HR-30 are separate build variants. Their safety components are not installed or cross-wired as one assembly.

g.text: NOTE 3: The start/feedback loop has no relay diagnostic for shorts or cross-shorts; route it separately or protect it and justify fault exclusion. 41-42 and Y32 are diagnostic only.

g.desc: NOTE 3: The start/feedback loop has no relay diagnostic for shorts or cross-shorts; route it separately or protect it and justify fault exclusion. 41-42 and Y32 are diagnostic only.

g.text: NOTE 4: FSRH1 and SKH1/SKH2 are mandatory selection gates. Verify output-contact protection, coil suppression, dropout, and stopping time before release.

g.desc: NOTE 4: FSRH1 and SKH1/SKH2 are mandatory selection gates. Verify output-contact protection, coil suppression, dropout, and stopping time before release.

g.text: 06 HR-30 source selection, dual-channel safety chain, redundant interruption, and upper-body conversion

g.desc: 06 HR-30 source selection, dual-channel safety chain, redundant interruption, and upper-body conversion
